BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: Can you tell me why it is common to haggle prices in the Middle East? ASSISTANT:

It is common to haggle prices in the Middle East because it is a traditional practice that is ingrained in the culture. It is seen as an way to demonstrate respect between the buyer and seller, as well as an opportunity for negotiation to secure the best deal for both parties. Additionally, haggling is seen as a way to honor the dignity of each individual. By negotiating, it shows a mutual respect for the value of the goods and services being exchanged.
